hooks.command: terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "$(basename "$PWD")" -message 'Done / idle' -group claude-code-stop -sound default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff 2>/dev/null & terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "$(basename "$PWD")" -message 'Question for you' -group claude-code-ask -activate com.googlecode.iterm2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

MSG=$(jq -r '.message // "Waiting for input"'); terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -subtitle "$(basename "$PWD")" -message "$MSG" -group claude-code-notify -sound Funk -activate com.googlecode.iterm2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
